thread:
Jules Park: Quick check — for the account settings bulk form with collapsed sections, should errors be inline-only or inline + a compact summary tray? Also what's our stance on required markers on collapsed headers?

Amir Shah: inline + summary tray. Inline for context, tray for discoverability when collapsed.

Lea Gómez: Summary items should be buttons that expand and focus fields. Keep tray dismissible and sr-only heading "Form errors".

Hana Ito: a11y: use aria-live="assertive" for the tray on submit, but debounce announcements. Ensure each input has aria-describedby pointing to its error.

Jules Park: copy idea for tray: "2 issues found — jump to fields". For required markers: asterisk + sr-only "required". On collapsed panels show "1 required" badge.

Amir Shah: destructive confirmation: perm delete = typed token (DELETE). soft delete/archive = checkbox confirm. Threshold: >150 items => typed token.

Lea Gómez: typed input should be visible, labeled, and errors if wrong. Don't autofill hidden values for screen readers.

ux-bot: accessibility-scan: warning: modal missing accessible name on branch feature/bulk. CI: https://ci.redwood.dev/4444

Jules Park: action items: Amir prototype tray+jump by Wed; Lea draft copy for confirmation by Fri; Hana write a11y test cases by Mon. Closing thread.
